title: Journal grep: the journal is searchable truth whose search view cannot leak — matchers AND together (case-sensitive substring over the type+payload JSON projection reaching tool names inside payloads, exact event type, exact payload tool name covering tool_call and tool_result alike, a since_seq floor whose first kept match is the real first surviving seq, a limit cap kept in seq order with 0 = uncapped); the empty result is honest (matched 0, matches [], the scanned total named in the render — never fabricated); a torn tail is isolated, never searched, only reported, with the dense prefix searched identically; a raw token hand-written into a journal at runtime matches on disk (the disk is the truth) yet prints only [REDACTED:github_token] — even when the pattern IS the raw token itself; output is byte-deterministic with no wall-clock; the CLI exits 0 on matches, 1 on no matches, 1 on a missing journal, and its stdout is redacted
